'''Joseph Gagliardi''' (also published as '''Joe Gagliardi''' and '''Joe Gigliardi''')<ref name="dt-11113">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11113 DeckTech post 11113], DeckTech (Joseph "dvmaba22" Gagliardi, 13 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11113/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11113/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018110137/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11113/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''dvmaba22''') posted a [[Light]] [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]] list on DeckTech in October 2000. As Joe Gagliardi he played the [[2014 Match Play Championship]], the [[2015 Match Play Championship]] and the [[2015 World Championship]].<ref name="pc-rem">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-world-championships/ 2015 World Championship], starwarsccg.org</ref>
